name: sweet tooth.
source:
Lindsey Henson messages her field partner Hallie Macleod for some comfort and a distraction during a particularly shitty night.

[From [url=https://snixiy.itch.io/sweet-tooth]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个格外糟糕的夜晚，琳赛·亨森给自己的外勤搭档哈莉·麦克劳德发了消息，想寻求一点安慰，也分散一下注意力。

（摘自[url=https://snixiy.itch.io/sweet-tooth]itch.io[/url]）
